parameters.name: AuthorizedSecurityGroups
parameters.description: An array that consists of the IDs of authorized security groups.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The ID of the bastion host.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the content within the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

*   **zh**: Chinese
*   **en**: English

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the bastion host.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-security-groups --lang zh --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --authorized-security-groups 2 --region cn-hangzhou
